oracle_provenance.swiglustep_and_mul: vLLM activation.py:359-365 (cross-checked; Triton kernel :27-52 emulation also agrees; llama.cpp llama-graph.cpp:1118-1135 corroborates silu-then-clamp)
oracle_provenance.v4_clamped: INFERRED: vLLM 739e5945d has no DeepSeek-V4 model; formula from lane brief. Two golden columns: symmetric gate clamp (golden) and gate clamp(max) only (golden_gate_max_only)

bfloat16.why: u=2^-9=2e-3; up to ~5 successive roundings if MLX keeps bf16 intermediates -> 1e-2; same rtol vLLM's own test_activation.py:90 uses for bf16.

tolerances.enforced_in: ConformanceSwigluGoldenTests.swift SwigluGolden.tolerances (this block only documents them; manifestComplete fails if they differ)

float16.why: u=2^-11=4.9e-4; ~5 roundings -> 2.5e-3 worst case, vLLM test uses 2e-3 (test_activation.py:90); atol = 1.7 subnormal steps (6e-8 each) for results below fp16 min normal 6.1e-5.

float32.why: u=6e-8; 5 roundings + Metal fast exp (<=3 ulp) is ~4e-7; 2e-6 leaves 5x margin. atol 1e-30 only guards denormal flush; the earlier 1e-20 made ~78 swigluoai goldens below 5e-15 effectively unchecked. swigluoai adds an exp-tail term |1.702*gate|*2*2^-24 (INFERRED conditioning argument).

tolerances.rule: |swift - golden| <= atol + rtol*|golden|; golden is exact float64 math on dtype-rounded inputs, so the budget is dtype rounding only. Set a priori from the dtype's unit roundoff u and the number of rounded operations (sigmoid, gate*sigmoid, *up, optional clamps which are exact): about 3-5 roundings plus a few ulp of fast-math exp.
